name: Minister 1
overview: The Scriptures in Numbers 18 emphasize the sacred responsibilities entrusted to ministers, particularly Aaron and his descendants, who are charged with bearing the iniquity of the sanctuary and priesthood. The Levites are given as a gift to assist in the service of the tabernacle, ensuring that the sanctuary and altar are properly cared for to prevent divine wrath upon Israel. These verses highlight both the solemn charge delivered to ministers and the vital duties the church must uphold in supporting and maintaining the ministry.
